        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        corners={(min(rs),min(cs)),(min(rs),max(cs)),(max(rs),min(cs)),(max(rs),max(cs))}
        if pts==corners and len(pts)==4:
            fc=c; fps=pts; break
    r0=min(p[0] for p in fps); r1=max(p[0] for p in fps)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in fps); c1=max(p[1] for p in fps)
    out=np.full((H,W),bgc,int)
    for a,b in fps: out[a,b]=fc
    ring=set([(a,b) for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1) if a in(r0,r1) or b in(c0,c1)])
    others=[(i,j,int(I[i,j])) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i,j]!=bgc and int(I[i,j])!=fc]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i,j]==bgc or int(I[i,j])==fc: continue
            c=int(I[i,j]); a,b=i,j
            ri=(r0+r1)/2; rj=(c0+c1)/2
            di=1 if ri>=i else -1; dj=1 if rj>=j else -1
